items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: One writer module, key precedence, drops-only run stamp and 16-hex ids, rotate-on-commit, F6 staging, absorb, F11 committed-check, F7b seal, event_amended, validators, docs; replay known set empty; KC4 test.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unreadable own drops fail closed (event_log_not_readable); torn drops are never committed; failed git operations reset the index.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Keys sanitized and capped at 80; git called with argument lists and --; no shell interpolation.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Legacy bytes pinned; real subprocess KC4 and real ensure_current absorb tests; lock, ordering, LF and replay tests.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Folder work only when the drops folder exists; legacy path takes the old code.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New modules under 300 lines; baselined files did not grow.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer (writers) and consumers (assembled reader, validator, F11 check, churn dedup, context index) exercised by real-producer replay and integration tests.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: No skipped or xfail tests added.
